description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 2 test patient, in which every mandatory section has a narrative summary and no structured entries. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 2 test patient, and only to that patient. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/Nictiz/NL-PS-IG/

valueString.value: NL-PS level 2: bearer token from your own system for your level 2 test patient
